extDescription.message: Speed up or slow down any video (YouTube, Twitch, Vimeo…) from 0.25x to 4x, across all tabs. S/D/R shortcuts, Force 1x option.

stepHint.message: Step used by the ± buttons and the S / D shortcuts (e.g. 0.10, 0.25, 0.5)

force1xHint.message: The extension watches the video and puts the speed back to 1.0x if it changes (useful when a site forces its own speed, e.g. 2x)

hideBadgeHint.message: The small “Speed …” badge at the top right of the video (and player) is no longer shown

hideFlashLabel.message: Hide the big speed display on change

hideFlashHint.message: The large “Speed …” in the middle of the video no longer appears when the speed changes (buttons, S / D shortcuts)

hideFlashOff.message: Big display on change shown again

soundFxHint.message: A short game-like "blip" on every change (S / D / R shortcuts, buttons): higher pitch = faster. Also toggled by the speaker icon in the menu. Always played when the video itself is fullscreen (nothing can be displayed over it).

withAudioHint.message: Off by default. Applies the speed to the audio players of web pages too (podcasts, audiobooks…). Sounds a site plays without an audio player on the page are not affected.
